rows.jp: 脱走させないための門は、とにかく厳めしいという印象があった。
rows.en: The gate meant to prevent escape had always struck me as forbidding.

ghs.en: This gate to prevent escape somehow still left an impression of austere dignity.

rows.jp: なぜ脱走させてはいけないか。
rows.en: Why couldn't anyone be allowed to escape?

ghs.en: Why is escape so strictly forbidden?

rows.jp: 人を傷つける可能性があるから。

ghs.en: Because there is a possibility that people would be hurt.

rows.jp: ま、一種の半隔離施設だ。
rows.en: Well, it's a kind of semi-isolation facility.

ghs.en: Well, it's kind of a half-isolation facility.

rows.jp: 安心していい、危険人物たちは滅びました。
rows.en: Rest easy: the dangerous individuals are extinct.

ghs.en: Be at ease now, the dangerous people have been annihilated.

rows.jp: 世界中に八人だけです。
rows.en: There are only eight of us in the whole world.

ghs.en: There are only eight people all throughout the world.

rows.jp: あと一般市民も滅びました。
rows.en: The general public went extinct too.

ghs.en: And the general public had also been annihilated.

rows.jp: だから被害者は出ません。
rows.en: So there can be no victims.

ghs.en: Therefore there shall be no victims.

rows.jp: 「と、自虐ネタはここまでにして」

ghs.en: Taichi: "And, the jokes tending towards the masochistic end here."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese term means self-deprecating or self-mocking; it does not mean masochistic here.

rows.jp: 死んだ貝のように開いたままの門を抜ける。
rows.en: I pass through the gate, still hanging open like a dead clam.

ghs.en: I pass through this gate open like a dead shellfish.
